name: Theo Hallenius
title: Blockchain/ML/Software Engineer
summary: Blockchain and software engineer and a generalist at heart. Involved in blockchain since 2017, most recently shipping Inco Lightning to mainnet. Founded several companies and gained management experience along the way. Big advocate for privacy and decentralization.
